wording: Gems will now be found more regularly when prospecting Midnight ore.

source.title: Hotfixes: April 17, 2026 (running list; entry under March 31, 2026)

affects: Inspiration-era profession processing; introduction of Concentration and Ingenuity
wording: Inspiration has been removed; Concentration and Ingenuity introduced as profession mechanics. No drop-rate magnitude specified.

source.title: The War Within Pre-Expansion Content Update Notes—Now Live! (Blizzard, July 24, 2024)

affects: The War Within Bismuth, Ironclaw Ore and Aqirite; gem output rate and item-quality scaling
wording: Improved the rate of prospecting gems for Bismuth, Ironclaw Ore, and Aqirite. This affects both baseline chances as well as the increase based on item quality.

affects: The War Within byproducts Glittering Glass 213399 and Handful of Pebbles 213398
wording: Byproducts, such as Glittering Glass and Handful of Pebbles, now drop from every Prospecting action (was a chance of Byproducts or gems).

affects: The War Within gem drop rates and maximum byproduct yield
wording: Slightly reduced the drop rates of gems and chance for maximum yield of Byproducts.

affects: The War Within Prospecting 40/40 specialization perk, Ambivalent Amber 212498
wording: Fixed a bug that prevented the Prospecting 40/40 specialization perk from providing Ambivalent Ambers as a byproduct.
